answer: Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. Each submission hangs on the vault of a task receipt, and the jetty is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. By the nadir of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
